policy: A dependency is not accepted or applicable merely because it is linked. Record the official evidence, route, pathway, text state, and unresolved EEA/national relationship. EEA EFTA, Schengen, Swiss, Nordic, returning-Icelandic-national, and ordinary national routes remain distinct.

dependencies.instrument: Directive 2004/38/EC as incorporated into the EEA Agreement by JCD 158/2007
dependencies.relationship: Principal EEA framework for Union citizens and qualifying family members; must be read through EEA incorporation, adaptations and Icelandic implementation rather than as EU-only national law.
dependencies.text_state: EFTA EEA-Lex identifies JCD 158/2007 and says the directive is incorporated and in force in the EEA. The Icelandic act and related sources are external references or summaries; the EEA act/JCD text is not retained as an accepted local legal text.
open_work: Retain and attribute the applicable EEA/JCD and Icelandic-language act text.
Map relevant directive provisions to the EEA adaptation and Act 80/2016/Regulation 540/2017, including the family-member and remedy route.

dependencies.instrument: Act No. 2/1993 on the European Economic Area
dependencies.relationship: National framework for the EEA Agreement and the legal effect of EEA acts; it does not by itself establish the status or national implementation of each specific EEA act.
dependencies.text_state: Current Alþingi consolidated edition 158a (1 October 2026) is an external reference only; no local text is accepted.
open_work: Retain the official current text with attribution and version evidence.
Map Act 2/1993's incorporation mechanism to the particular EEA acts used in each pathway.

dependencies.instrument: Foreign Nationals Act No. 80/2016 and Foreign Nationals Regulation No. 540/2017, as amended
dependencies.relationship: National immigration and procedure framework. EEA/EFTA residence rights must remain analytically distinct from national permits, visa rules, and other nationality routes.
dependencies.text_state: Act 80/2016 is an official current consolidation reference, not a retained text. The base Regulation 540/2017 PDF available through the official record is stale. Complete local Icelandic texts of amendments 669/2026, 724/2026 and 725/2026 are accepted separately; they do not make a current consolidated regulation.
open_work: Obtain or reconstruct a complete current official Regulation 540/2017 text only from verified official material and establish every amendment/effective date.
Map Chapter XI and applicable rules to each Directive/EEA provision and to the specific P01-P05 route.
Keep future Act 48/2026 amendments effective 1 December 2026 separate from law in force on the review date.

dependencies.instrument: Council Regulation (EU) 2025/1208 on identity cards and residence documents for free movement
dependencies.relationship: Potential card-format dependency. EU commencement or an EU 'EEA relevance' label does not establish Icelandic EEA applicability.
dependencies.text_state: A prior official EFTA screen recorded a draft JCD under consideration. Direct re-open of the EFTA page returned 403 on 31 October 2026; current adopted-JCD status, adaptations and entry date are not verified here. No local Icelandic EEA incorporation text is retained.
open_work: Recheck the EFTA EEA-Lex record and any adopted JCD, adaptations and entry date.
If incorporated, verify Icelandic implementation, current card specimen and transition rule against retained official text.

dependencies.instrument: Schengen Visa Code (Regulation (EC) No 810/2009), VIS Regulation (EC) No 767/2008, and Icelandic Visa Act No. 37/2026
dependencies.relationship: Visa law governs visa decisions and ordinary Schengen procedures; an EEA family-member facilitation route must not be collapsed into an ordinary C-visa checklist. Visa Act No. 37/2026 took effect 12 May 2026 and identifies Schengen regulations 810/2009 and 767/2008.
dependencies.text_state: The Icelandic Act is an official consolidated reference only; the Schengen instruments and national act are not retained as complete local texts. The C-visa mission locator is dynamic and does not cover every D-visa or EEA-family route.
open_work: Retain the current Icelandic visa statute and applicable Schengen text/EEA status with exact version and attribution.
Map decision types, responsible ministry/mission, documentary rules, filing channel and the Visa Act §17 complaint route without applying it to residence-card decisions.

dependencies.instrument: Administrative Procedure Act No. 37/1993 and decision-specific special rules
dependencies.relationship: General procedure may apply to administrative decisions subject to special statutory rules. Visa Act No. 37/2026 has its own scope and complaint route; procedural chapter exclusions must be mapped before describing a visa remedy.
dependencies.text_state: Current Alþingi consolidated edition 158a is an external reference only. No local full text, decision-to-remedy matrix or current judicial-route crosswalk is accepted.
open_work: Retain the relevant current statutory provisions.
For each refusal, delay, residence-card or visa decision, map notice, reasons, deadline, appeal, exhaustion, interim relief and judicial review.
Do not derive an operative deadline from general guidance alone.

dependencies.instrument: GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) as incorporated by JCD 154/2018, and Icelandic Data Protection Act No. 90/2018
dependencies.relationship: The official EFTA factsheet identifies JCD 154/2018 and says GDPR is incorporated and in force in the EEA. Act 90/2018 §2 gives the EEA-incorporated GDPR legal effect in Iceland subject to JCD adaptations. Administrative records and any law-enforcement processing still require controller and purpose-specific analysis.
dependencies.text_state: Both official pages are references only; neither the full local Act nor applicable GDPR/JCD text is retained in this Iceland pack.
open_work: Retain the Icelandic Data Protection Act and applicable GDPR/JCD text with version, attribution and local conversion evidence.
Map controller, record system, purpose, access/correction/restriction/retention route, exceptions and supervisory complaint for the actual data request.

dependencies.instrument: Civil-status, family-relationship, translation/authentication and public-document rules for EEA-family evidence
dependencies.relationship: Evidence requirements depend on family category and document origin. The service summary does not replace controlling law or determine whether a particular document is covered by EU public-document rules.
dependencies.text_state: The EEA family evidence material is an accepted project-authored summary plus official locator. The relevant Icelandic civil-status and document-law texts and the applicable language/authentication rules are not locally retained or mapped article by article.
open_work: Identify family status, dependency/durable relationship, public-document type, issuing state, translation, legalization/apostille and exceptions.
Retain the official rules needed for covered document types and separately identify alternatives and supplementary-document limits.

dependencies.instrument: Separate Swiss, Nordic, Icelandic-return, and ordinary national family routes
dependencies.relationship: Route-navigation evidence only. Swiss treaty rights, Nordic registration, return by an Icelandic citizen, and ordinary national-family permits cannot be substituted for the EEA/EFTA family route.
dependencies.text_state: Official service pages are locators; the separate Swiss agreement and national route laws are not retained in this pack.
open_work: Keep the route decision tree and personal-scope rule explicit.
Locate and retain current governing texts only when an existing product issue requires the relevant route.

dependencies.instrument: EEA registration threshold, residence-card applications, and Directorate processing status
dependencies.relationship: Separate legal duration/registration rule, actual application receipt, appointment delay and aggregate authority processing metrics. Current service guidance conflicts: one page body says more than three months while its heading/form and another page say more than six months.
dependencies.text_state: Official dynamic service evidence; direct re-open returned 403 on 31 October 2026. is-13 is historical guidance. No legal threshold is selected from the conflicting pages.
open_work: Resolve the duration/registration requirement against primary current provisions.
Refresh waiting-time page date and preserve its category, approval-only denominator and non-individual-estimate limit.
Map the exact event that starts any legal processing period.

dependencies.instrument: Immigration Appeals Board decisions, Icelandic court judgments, and judicial review procedure
dependencies.relationship: Administrative publication is selective and redacted; court-search entry point and corpus coverage have not been verified. A publication portal is not itself the remedy rule or proof of complete case-law coverage.
dependencies.text_state: Official links only. No exhaustive query, full case-law corpus, retained procedural text or route-specific remedy crosswalk is accepted.
open_work: Specify courts, databases, languages, query terms, date range and selection limits for a screened case-law batch.
Map the judicial remedy separately for Immigration Appeals Board and first-instance authority decisions.
Retain the operative court-procedure provisions before publishing deadlines or admissibility statements.
